Company Comments for Initial version of draft CR No comments were received for the draft CR v00. Moderator assumes it ok for approval. Chairman has declared endorsement of draft CR v00. Agreement Draft CR TS38215_Rel19_CRdraft_LPWUS_v00 is endorsed in principle. RAN1 #122-bis: Agreement Endorse the following TP for TS
